### Context ###
- The operator found the wiki's CO "normal with cat" maximum (P1) above the legal idle limit and ordered every number
  checked at a primary source. These 20 claims decide two fixes: the CO normal range (T-GASA-F45) and the Euro ceiling
  table that the code uses as fault bounds (T-GASA-FEURO, `resolution.py` `_EURO_THRESHOLDS`).
- Candidate primary sources (not exhaustive, verify each): the gov.uk MOT inspection manual section 8 (P3); DVSA "In
  Service Exhaust Emission Standards for Road Vehicles" 19th edition (gov.uk assets PDF); Directive 2014/45/EU Annex I
  8.2.1 (EUR-Lex); the Euro type-approval acts (Directive 91/441/EEC, 94/12/EC, 98/69/EC, Regulation (EC) 715/2007),
  which set g/km drive-cycle limits plus an idle CO test; the SAE J1667 abstract and the US two-speed idle test
  (40 CFR Part 85 Subpart W) for the high-idle band claims.
